name: Outside
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Matrei in Osttirol – your gateway to the heart of the Alps!**

Nestled in the breathtaking **Zillertal Alps**, **Matrei in Osttirol** invites you to experience the raw beauty of the High Tauern National Park. Whether you're hiking through untouched wilderness, admiring the dramatic peaks of the **Granatspitze** and **Hochgall**, or simply soaking in the serene atmosphere of this alpine paradise, every moment here feels like stepping into a postcard.

**Explore the great outdoors:**
From gentle valley walks to challenging multi-day treks, the trails around **Matrei** offer something for every adventurer. Don’t miss the iconic **Matreier Tauern Road**, a scenic drive with jaw-dropping views, or the **Hochtor Pass**, where you can marvel at the vastness of the **Hohe Tauern** range.

**Cultural gems & local flavors:**
Discover the charming old town with its traditional **Tiroler** architecture and cozy **Gasthöfe** (inns). Warm up with a hearty bowl of **Kaiserschmarrn** or **Tiroler Gröstl** at a local café, paired with a glass of crisp **Tiroler Apfelwein**. The **Matrei Museum** offers fascinating insights into the region’s history and folklore.

**Year-round adventures:**
In winter, **Matrei** transforms into a snowy wonderland, with cross-country skiing trails and access to nearby ski resorts like **Hochzillertal**. Summer brings wildflower meadows, alpine lakes like the **Längsee**, and the chance to spot ibex and marmots in their natural habitat.

**Stay & relax:**
Choose from rustic mountain lodges to modern hotels—all with stunning views of the surrounding peaks. After a day of exploration, unwind in a **Sauna** or enjoy a traditional **Tiroler Abendmusik** (evening concert) under the stars.

**Matrei in Osttirol – where adventure meets tradition!** 🏔️✨
